title: hieracium pilosum subsp. villosiceps
intro: Hieracium pilosum subsp. villosiceps, commonly known as the hairy hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The hairy hawkweed is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit antifungal and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium pilosum subsp. villosiceps include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
